findings.desc: doc-code-drift: lifecycle-artifact-scope.md §Contract point 2 and execution-plan §Implementation Status both state that `lattice agent_prompt` serves content from `promptRegistryManifest()`, but the actual implementation calls `readPromptTemplate(entry)` (reads raw file bytes from templates/agents/*.md). `promptRegistryManifest()` returns only manifest metadata (schemaVersion/source/agentCount/materialHash), not template content. The behavioral outcome (same-source read) is correct, but the API reference is wrong and could mislead a developer to call the wrong function.
